verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a library of plain markdown skills installed into coding-agent harnesses such as Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI. It operates no service that collects user data and trains no models, so a training-data opt-out is a category error for this product type. Any such control belongs to the host harness or model provider, and the evidence shows no first-party data-handling feature that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
